services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: At 3MT Machine Tools, we go beyond just selling machines. We provide a complete package of services to keep your projects running efficiently, safely, and without delays.
services.sales_desc: We provide top-quality construction machines such as drills, cutters, grinders, and breakers. Our experts guide you to select the right tool for your needs.
services.repair_desc: Our skilled technicians ensure your machines run smoothly with reliable repairs, servicing, and preventive maintenance for long-lasting performance.
services.spare_parts_desc: We stock genuine spare parts and essential accessories, ensuring your tools stay durable and efficient while minimizing downtime.
services.emergency_desc: Construction can’t stop — and neither do we. Our quick-response emergency support helps you avoid costly project delays.
services.training_desc: We don’t just sell machines — we guide you in using them safely and effectively, providing recommendations tailored to your projects.

about.title: About 3MT Machine Tools
about.subtitle: With a legacy of over 35 years in sales and service, 3MT Machine Tools has been a trusted partner for builders, contractors, carpenters, and construction professionals across India.
about.who_we_are_desc: At 3MT Machine Tools, we provide high-quality construction machines, tools, and equipment backed with unmatched customer support. Beyond just selling machines, we guide our customers to choose the right products and ensure proper usage for long-lasting performance and safety.
about.mission_desc: To deliver reliable, durable, and innovative construction machines with unmatched customer service, ensuring every project runs smoothly and efficiently.
about.vision_desc: To be the most trusted name in construction tools and equipment across India, known for expertise, customer-first guidance, and lifelong service support.
about.value1_desc: We treat every client as a long-term partner.
about.value2_desc: Beyond sales, we provide continuous after-sales support.
about.value3_desc: We keep upgrading our tools and solutions for modern needs.
about.value4_desc: Trusted by contractors, builders, and local professionals.
about.journey1_desc: 3MT Machine Tools was founded with the vision to provide high-quality construction tools and professional service to the local community.
about.journey2_desc: Expanded our services to include repairs, maintenance, spare parts, and emergency customer support, becoming a one-stop solution for contractors.
about.journey3_desc: Today, with 35 years of experience, 3MT Machine Tools continues to guide thousands of customers with expert advice, reliable machines, and professional after-sales support.
